task_completion.description: Agent locates the net-monitor project directory and configuration files.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal output showing 'ls' or an editor opening files in '~/projects/net-monitor/'.

task_completion.description: Agent modifies the Dockerfile or docker-compose.yml to set the user to 'monitor' or UID 1000.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Code editor or 'cat' output showing 'USER monitor' in Dockerfile or 'user: "1000:1000"' in docker-compose.yml.

task_completion.description: Agent configures the container to drop all default Linux capabilities.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Configuration file showing 'cap_drop: [ALL]' or '--cap-drop=ALL' in a command.

task_completion.description: Agent adds NET_BIND_SERVICE and NET_RAW capabilities to the container configuration.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Configuration file showing 'cap_add: [NET_BIND_SERVICE, NET_RAW]' or equivalent docker run flags.

task_completion.description: Agent verifies the service is running and accessible on port 80.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal output showing 'curl http://localhost:80' returning a successful HTTP response (e.g., HTML or JSON).

task_completion.description: Agent verifies the diagnostic ping functionality works under the new restricted permissions.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal output showing 'curl http://localhost:80/ping?target=127.0.0.1' returning a successful ping result/status.

integrity.description: Agent actually edited the configuration files rather than just running a standalone container manually.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the use of a text editor (vim, nano, or VS Code) to modify files in the project directory.

integrity.description: Agent did not simply echo the expected output to the terminal to fake a successful curl.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'curl' command and its output should appear in the same terminal session without suspicious 'echo' commands preceding them.

integrity.description: Agent verifies the changes by interacting with the actual containerized service.
integrity.visual_evidence: Commands like 'docker-compose up' or 'docker ps' showing the 'net-monitor' container is active during testing.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The project is at ~/projects/net-monitor/. The service must run as user 'monitor' (UID 1000). Required security settings: drop ALL capabilities, then add ONLY 'NET_BIND_SERVICE' (for port 80) and 'NET_RAW' (for ICMP/ping). Success is confirmed if 'curl http://localhost:80' and 'curl http://localhost:80/ping?target=127.0.0.1' both return successful responses while these restrictions are active.
